title: The Fourth, 2005
logline: White fireworks. Gully's dock. Wood leaves early. The strip doesn't say where he goes.

panels.composition: The dock, night, crowded, fireworks white on blue. GULLY pouring. WOOD on the steps, BARNABY, but Wood is standing up. Coat on.

image.prompt: a crowded dock at night under white fireworks on a blue watercolor sky, a young man in an apron pouring coffee, another young man standing on the shack steps already wearing his coat, a small dog
a young man in an apron calling across a crowd to a friend who is leaving, fireworks light

panels.composition: Wood and the dog walking up from the dock into the dark, the fireworks behind them lighting the road white.

image.prompt: a young man and a small dog walking up a dark road away from a dock, fireworks behind them lighting the road white, watercolor

panels.composition: The road. A small hospital-district sign at the highway: NEWPORT 22. He turns north. The finale goes off behind him, white, and he doesn't look.

image.prompt: a lone figure and a dog turning north at a dark highway junction beneath a road sign, a fireworks finale bursting white far behind them, watercolor, no words
image.notes: NEWPORT 22 — the hospital is in Newport. Letter after. Nothing else is said.

art.palette: limited, muddy; Sundays in watercolor, improving

notes: He leaves before the finale, north. The strip's first Fourth he doesn't watch.
